status: pre-results frozen research protocol; custom simulator, not native Jesse
period_policy: Independent flat-start runs with 10000 USDT; warmup from prior data. Force-close at period end and report separately. Later validation only if complete real data exists; not proof of author-untouched holdout.

signal_semantics.forming_anchor: At each completed trading bar, use completed anchor history plus current partial anchor, or final anchor at boundary. Pending fire remains until signal disappears; consume anchor timestamp only when entering, matching supplied code.
signal_semantics.closed_anchor_once: At each anchor boundary evaluate just-closed anchor, assign eligible entry to close of first subsequent trading bar, as described by author. Evaluate ADX/slope on same frozen closed anchor. For trading TF=anchor this introduces a full-anchor wait, explicitly reported. Trail uses latest closed anchor ATR at each trading close.

execution.sizing: corrected Jesse risk_to_qty semantics, 3 percent of available cash, 1x cap; fee keyword fixed; conservative quantity floor 0.001 ETH
execution.entry: next 1m open after trading-bar signal close; adverse slippage
execution.stop: existing stop checked on every 1m high/low; gap uses worse open; adverse slippage
execution.trailing: ratchet on completed trading-bar closes; only active for following minute
execution.funding: actual historical funding rates at their recorded timestamps; traded 1m open used as notional proxy instead of exact mark price; carried positions charged before entries at same timestamp
execution.limits: No order-book queue/depth, liquidation, latency distribution, or exact mark-price funding simulation. 1x notional cap. Not an exact replay of author's unknown exchange/config/version.

selection_policy: No parameter optimization. Show all requested TF and both semantics. Comparing TF consumes this dataset for selection; best TF is exploratory, not confirmed out-of-sample winner.
validation: Require checksum-verified downloads, full-minute continuity, finite valid OHLC, funding coverage; meaningful synthetic event tests; indicator source audit; causal prefix-invariance checks. Report actual data availability without substituting generated candles.
